new_row.relationship: Unsupported equivalence of life images; not retained
new_row.rationale: Job 9:25 explicitly compares life with a swift runner. Job 7:6 calls life lighter than chatter and says it perished in empty hope. The latter does not itself establish the same image of speed; the initially retained general-fragility comparison was removed and remains uncredited.

changes.reason: Preserve the read but removed draft comparison separately at zero credit.
